ctx.x: Charlie Haughton, I believe. Charlie Haughton, a wonderful trombonist who, in a manner of speaking, took me under his wing in that I would go to his house on

Sunday afternoons and take a lesson from him. I looked forward to going to his home on Sunday afternoons taking lessons, trombone lessons. I looked forward to going to the rehearsals where we played all these fantastic Sousa marches. Stars and Stripes Forever is one that comes to my mind. There were a zillion of them. That’s the only one I can think of. I know David [Baker] appreciates the fact that these Sousa marches always had interesting trombone parts. It was contrapuntal to the rest of whatever the…
